## Release Notes

### Bug Fixes

- *(ai)* Parse SKILL.md frontmatter with CRLF line endings ([#4758](https://github.com/atuinsh/atuin/issues/4758))
- *(ai)* Resolve in-flight tools when the chat stream fails ([#4759](https://github.com/atuinsh/atuin/issues/4759))
- *(ai)* Don't re-prompt the model after server-side tool calls ([#4310](https://github.com/atuinsh/atuin/issues/4310))
- *(daemon)* Search index race conditions ([#4730](https://github.com/atuinsh/atuin/issues/4730))
- *(mcp)* Keep the Atuin for Teams tool list cached from the daemon, and keep it through a failed call ([#4726](https://github.com/atuinsh/atuin/issues/4726))
- *(mcp)* Tell Atuin for Teams which thread is calling, and load atuin_history up front ([#4768](https://github.com/atuinsh/atuin/issues/4768))
- *(nushell)* Make keybindings work in helix mode ([#4738](https://github.com/atuinsh/atuin/issues/4738))
- *(opencode)* Write handed-off tool calls as opencode 2's own shell, read, write and edit ([#4665](https://github.com/atuinsh/atuin/issues/4665))
- *(pty-proxy)* Don't spawn pty when piped ([#4734](https://github.com/atuinsh/atuin/issues/4734))
- *(pty-proxy)* Propagate outer terminal pixel size to inner PTY ([#4619](https://github.com/atuinsh/atuin/issues/4619))
- *(setup)* Let enter expand/close submenus ([#4771](https://github.com/atuinsh/atuin/issues/4771))
- *(setup)* Ignore comments in shell init files ([#4772](https://github.com/atuinsh/atuin/issues/4772))
- *(threads)* Don't offer agents atuin can't write to as --in targets ([#4662](https://github.com/atuinsh/atuin/issues/4662))
- *(threads)* Catch a Claude Code copy up past its own turn_duration line ([#4733](https://github.com/atuinsh/atuin/issues/4733))
- *(threads)* Keep omp background job results and notices ([#4773](https://github.com/atuinsh/atuin/issues/4773))
- *(userio)* Escape control characters in messages for the user ([#4757](https://github.com/atuinsh/atuin/issues/4757))
- Standardize path to `atuin` in external config ([#4766](https://github.com/atuinsh/atuin/issues/4766))
- Create the key file without a hard link on Android/Termux ([#4767](https://github.com/atuinsh/atuin/issues/4767))


### Documentation

- *(readme)* Rework the README around rendered demos
- Adjust readme ([#4747](https://github.com/atuinsh/atuin/issues/4747))


### Features

- *(config)* Warn about and avoid setting unknown keys ([#4727](https://github.com/atuinsh/atuin/issues/4727))
- *(setup)* Make atuin setup the way to set atuin up
- *(setup)* Further atuin setup improvements
- *(setup)* Individually select arrow and checkbox ([#4774](https://github.com/atuinsh/atuin/issues/4774))
- *(threads)* Read content blocks of kinds a newer atuin added ([#4735](https://github.com/atuinsh/atuin/issues/4735))
- Move datetime handling to jiff, with DST-aware time zones ([#4765](https://github.com/atuinsh/atuin/issues/4765))


### Miscellaneous Tasks

- *(ai)* Remove the Atuin AI agent ([#4764](https://github.com/atuinsh/atuin/issues/4764))
- *(theme)* Remove theme.max_depth and theme.debug ([#4755](https://github.com/atuinsh/atuin/issues/4755))
- Update agent instructions ([#4754](https://github.com/atuinsh/atuin/issues/4754))
- Move release skill to `.agents` ([#4775](https://github.com/atuinsh/atuin/issues/4775))


### Performance

- *(daemon)* Update the search index in place on delete ([#4743](https://github.com/atuinsh/atuin/issues/4743))


### Refactor

- Ensure ai features are gated by "ai" crate feature ([#4756](https://github.com/atuinsh/atuin/issues/4756))


### Testing

- *(common)* Keep repo walk proptest clear of Windows device names

detail.readme:
making your terminal magical

Atuin gives you, and your agents, a history of everything that happened in your terminal. **Shell history** Atuin replaces your shell history with a SQLite database that records exit codes, working directories, hosts and durations. Hit Ctrlr and find any command you've ever run, on any machine. **Agent Threads** Atuin captures your Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and other agent sessions. Start a thread on your laptop, then `atuin resume` it on a different machine, in a different harness. Your agents can, optionally, search everything that's ever happened through the built-in MCP server. Atuin can also sync both history and threads across all of your machines, end-to-end encrypted. Or it can work totally offline! # Quick Start ```bash curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -LsSf https://setup.atuin.sh | sh ``` Then, **restart your shell**. ## History Atuin captures everything you do in the terminal, storing it into a SQLite database. Hitting CTRLr opens a pretty pane with all your bash history. Atuin logs your _exit codes_, _working directories_, _hostnames_, _command duration_ and much much more. You can hit Return to execute a command, Tab to edit any highlighted command.

Agents can search your history too:

As well as the search UI, `atuin` has a CLI interface for searching commands: ```bash # search for all successful `make` commands, recorded after 3pm yesterday atuin search --exit 0 --after "yesterday 3pm" make ``` ## Threads Atuin captures what your agents do. Automatically move your context and thread history from one machine to another, or from one harness to another. With _Atuin Threads_, your agent has access to your full history, and the built-in Atuin MCP gives your agent context on everything you've ever done.

You can take a session you started on your personal computer in Claude Code, and `$ atuin resume` it in a remote machine inside Codex.

Similarly to the _history_ index, you can search through your _threads_: ```bash atuin threads search 'c++' ``` ## Sync Atuin syncs all your AI threads, your shell sessions across all your computers (even ephemeral VMs!). You can either use the official [Atuin Service](https://atuin.sh) or you can self-host the sync server. **Everything it syncs is end-to-end encrypted.** ## Atuin supports [ `zsh`](https://www.zsh.org/), [ `bash`](https://www.gnu.org/software/bash/), [ `fish`](https://fishshell.com/), [ `nushell`](https://www.nushell.sh/), [ `xonsh`](https://xon.sh/) and [ `PowerShell`](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powershell/) as well as [ `Claude Code`](https://claude.com/product/claude-code), [ `Codex`](https://openai.com/codex/), [ Opencode](https://opencode.ai/), [ Copilot](https://github.com/features/copilot), [ Grok](https://x.ai/build), [ Hermes](https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/), and many more. Atuin does so much more and we have [extensive documentation](https://docs.atuin.sh/)! If you ever need help, reach out to us through our [communities](#community). ## Related projects * [Catpuccin for Atuin](https://github.com/catppuccin/atuin) * [eshell-atuin](https://github.com/SqrtMinusOne/eshell-atuin) * [mob (tiny creatures in your terminal)](https://github.com/bboynton97/mob) Please open a PR for any others! # Community
